idea-plugin.name: Code Prism
idea-plugin.description:
Code Prism brings focused, depth-based color to structured code.

Today, it colors YAML mapping keys and XML element names by structural depth with a configurable palette, making nested configuration easier to scan while preserving normal syntax colors.

This is a deliberately focused first step toward language-aware structural coloring for nested source structures. Support for additional languages is a future direction, not a feature of this release.
